title: Dendrobium nobile active ingredient Dendrobin A against hepatocellular carcinoma via inhibiting nuclear factor kappa-B signaling.
authors: Yu, Yaping; Fan, Yonghao; Mei, Wenli; Xu, Xiaoqing; Chen, Yan; Zhao, Yangyang; Ruan, Banzhan; Shen, Zhihua; Lu, Yanda; Zheng, Shaojiang; Jie, Wei
one_liner_zh: 研究中药活性成分Dendrobin A通过抑制NF-kappaB信号通路抗肝癌，分子对接仅用于小分子-蛋白结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Dendrobin A, a typical active ingredient of the traditional Chinese medicine Dendrobium nobile, has potential clinical application in cancer treatment; however, its effect and mechanism in anti-hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) remain unsolved. METHOD: The effects of Dendrobin A on the viability, migration, invasion, cycle, apoptosis, and epithelial-mesenchymal transition of HepG2 and SK-HEP-1 cells were verified by in vitro experiments. mRNA sequencing was performed to screen the differentially expressed genes (DEGs) of HCC cells before and after Dendrobin A treatment, following GO enrichment and KEGG signaling pathway analyses. Mechanistically, molecular docking was used to evaluate the binding of Dendrobin A with proteins p65 and p50, before further verifying the activation of nuclear factor kappa-B (NF-kappaB) signaling. Finally, the antiproliferative effect of Dendrobin A on HCC cells was explored through animal experiments. RESULTS: Dendrobin A arrested cell cycle, induced apoptosis, and inhibited proliferation, migration, invasion, and blocked epithelial-mesenchymal transition in HepG2 and SK-HEP-1 cells. mRNA sequencing identified 830 DEGs, involving various biological processes. KEGG analysis highlighted NF-kappaB signaling. Molecular docking revealed strong binding of Dendrobin A with p65 and p50 proteins, and western blotting confirmed reduced levels of p-p65 and p-p50 in HCC cells post Dendrobin A treatment. NF-kappaB agonist PMA reversed Dendrobin A-inhibited cell proliferation migration and invasion. In vivo experiments showed that Dendrobin A inhibited HCC cell growth. CONCLUSION: Our findings suggest that Dendrobin A exhibits anti-HCC properties by inhibiting the activation of the NF-kappaB pathway. These results provide a scientific basis for utilizing Dendrobium nobile in anti-HCC therapies.
abstract_zh: 目的： Dendrobin A 是传统中药金钗石斛的典型活性成分，在癌症治疗中具有潜在临床应用价值；然而，其在抗肝细胞癌（HCC）中的作用及机制尚未明确。方法： 通过体外实验验证Dendrobin A对HepG2和SK-HEP-1细胞活力、迁移、侵袭、周期、凋亡及上皮-间质转化的影响。采用mRNA测序筛选Dendrobin A处理前后HCC细胞的差异表达基因（DEGs），并进行GO富集和KEGG信号通路分析。机制上，利用分子对接评估Dendrobin A与p65和p50蛋白的结合，进一步验证核因子kappa-B（NF-kappaB）信号的激活。最后，通过动物实验探讨Dendrobin A对HCC细胞的抗增殖作用。结果： Dendrobin A阻滞细胞周期、诱导凋亡，并抑制HepG2和SK-HEP-1细胞的增殖、迁移、侵袭及上皮-间质转化。mRNA测序鉴定出830个DEGs，涉及多种生物学过程。KEGG分析突出NF-kappaB信号通路。分子对接显示Dendrobin A与p65和p50蛋白强结合，Western blotting证实Dendrobin A处理后HCC细胞中p-p65和p-p50水平降低。NF-kappaB激动剂PMA逆转了Dendrobin A抑制的细胞增殖、迁移和侵袭。体内实验表明，Dendrobin A抑制HCC细胞生长。结论： 我们的发现表明，Dendrobin A通过抑制NF-kappaB通路激活发挥抗HCC特性。这些结果为利用金钗石斛进行抗HCC治疗提供了科学依据。
